style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news
prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph of a jammed automatic tool changer carousel on a precision milling machine. Visible machine oil, frosted metal surfaces, and gleaming aluminum shavings. 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane on the jammed collision point, shallow depth of field with the dark workshop background falling away into soft bokeh. Soft directional daylight, high-texture industrial storytelling.

rationale: An editorial macro photograph of a jammed, overloaded mechanical tool carousel perfectly physicalizes the software problem of an agent failing when handed too many tools, emphasizing the architectural budget through tangible hardware limits.

subject: an overloaded and jammed CNC tool changer carousel
alt_text: An overloaded and jammed mechanical tool carousel filled with colliding titanium drill bits and milling heads.
caption: Handing an AI agent a massive catalogue of tools crashes its selection accuracy, much like overloading a physical mechanism.
title: Overloaded AI Agent Tool Catalogue
